content.title: About
content.content: The Ham Biscuit Sandwich is a quick snack consisting of a slice of ham placed between two dry biscuit crackers. It is often served in school cafeterias and as a light lunch option.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: A similar product first appeared in the United States in the 1950s as part of military rations.
The biscuits used are usually unsweetened, making the sandwich less sweet than typical deli sandwiches.
The ham is often smoked, giving the sandwich a distinctive aroma and extending shelf life.
The sandwich is easy to pack in individual portions, popular at buffets and catering events.
In some regions it is served with mustard or mayonnaise to boost flavor.

items.title: Source of protein
items.content: Ham provides high‑quality animal protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: Ham is rich in heme iron, which is more readily absorbed than plant‑based iron.

items.title: Energy dense
items.content: The combination of ham and biscuits offers a quick source of calories useful during increased physical activity.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Ham supplies thiamine, riboflavin, and niacin, supporting carbohydrate metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Convenient and portable
items.content: No heating is required, making it practical for travel and on‑the‑go consumption.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Ham is often salty, so individuals with hypertension should limit intake.

items.title: Preservatives and nitrites
items.content: Some ham varieties contain additives that may be undesirable with frequent consumption.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: The biscuits may contain wheat, which is important for people with celiac disease.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: The meat‑and‑biscuit combo can be calorie‑rich; portion control is recommended.

items.title: Shelf life
items.content: After opening, keep the sandwich refrigerated and consume within 2‑3 days.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The sandwich can be eaten straight from the pack, cut into bite‑size pieces for children, or topped with mustard, mayonnaise, or fresh vegetables for added flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 2‑4 °C in the original packaging. After opening, seal tightly or transfer to an airtight container. Do not keep for more than 5 days.
